name: kms:Decrypt on * subsumes the same-statement WILDCARD-RESOURCE (IAM-201)
note: kms:Decrypt on Resource "*" trips BOTH KMS-DECRYPT (the decryption capability) and the generic WILDCARD-RESOURCE (broad scope) on the SAME statement. IAM-201 folds the WILDCARD-RESOURCE row INTO the more-specific KMS-DECRYPT finding as a risk factor (nothing lost: it is preserved in subsumed[] and reflected in the risk-factor checklist), so the KMS statement yields ONE primary KMS-DECRYPT finding rather than a duplicate WILDCARD-RESOURCE row. The four other statements are scoped and each yield a single capability finding, so the total primaries drop from 6 (pre-correlation rule set) to 5 (post-correlation). Because every non-KMS statement is resource-scoped, none of them trips WILDCARD-RESOURCE, and the only broad-resource grant is the one subsumed here - so the Standalone broad-resource findings count is 0.

compound.note: The WILDCARD-RESOURCE on statement 0 is the broad-resource scope of the KMS-DECRYPT capability on that same statement, so it is subsumed. The other capability findings sit on scoped statements and trip no WILDCARD-RESOURCE.
